cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Blames Moonshot for Mass Data Extraction on Its AI Models
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI accused its Chinese rival Moonshot AI of being responsible for a wide-scale effort to extract data from its GPT artificial intelligence systems that could be used to reproduce the reasoning and capabilities of the company’s most advanced models.

The chips, which are not available in China, sit in several Oracle data centres in South-East Asia. The deal, signed this year, is worth about $7bn, and Tencent […] This story continues at The Next Web

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Targets $30 Billion Funding at $1.4 Trillion Value
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI aims to raise at least $30 billion from investors in a new round of funding, according to people familiar with the matter. The company is seeking a valuation of around $1.4 trillion, not including the money raised, said the people. This comes after the artificial intelligence startup pushed back its plans for an initial public offering. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI SEEKS $30B AT $1.4 TRILLION VALUATION

TIME has published the full transcript, along with a […] This story continues at The Next Web

cluster_stories.summary: Broadcom has agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42bn to help pay for its AI infrastructure, Reuters reported on Thursday, citing Anthropic’s IPO prospectus. The loan could cover about a third of the $125.2bn Anthropic has committed to a five-year lease of tensor processing units (TPUs), the AI chips Google designs with Broadcom.
